one_month_reasoning: Q3-26 results land inside the window, probably Tue 2026-10-20 (Vicor reports on the third Tuesday). Revenue is pre-announced at >30% q/q (>~$186M) [7], so what moves the stock is (a) the first split of the ~$29M VPD royalty into back-payment and run-rate, (b) the Q4 guide and whether product revenue reached the ~$137M implied by July's guide [2], and (c) product gross margin, which was hurt by relocation costs in Q2 [2]. Hyperscaler capex calls in late October also fall in the window [23]. Against that, the stock is up ~66% since 2026-09-16 on two guidance raises, in July it fell on a beat because operating income declined y/y [14], and insiders keep selling under 10b5-1 plans (CEO 18,100 shares on 2026-10-01 at $306-330 [9]). Those sales are routine and small against an 8.3M-share holding, so I give them little weight. I centre the month just below spot (median ~$299) with a ~29% log-sd (95%/3.5 plus a little for the report) and take no strong directional view.

fair_value.method: Recurring earnings only. NTM recurring EPS at Oct-2027 ~$5.90 (ex-interest; CY2027 $4.39, CY2028 $6.73 incl. interest) valued at the 25.5x CY2027 power-peer median (royalties at 20x) plus ~$10/share net cash and a ~$10 licensing option: SOTP $159 (0.45), P/E $160 (0.35), DCF $146 (0.20; D&A add-back 4.2% of revenue) -> 0.45 x 159 + 0.35 x 160 + 0.20 x 146 = $156.75 -> ~$157.

bear.story: Q3 shows most of the ~$29M VPD royalty was back-payment and the run-rate is under $10M/qtr. The late-2027 licence renewals reprice down or 337-TA-1484 fails (final determination due 2027-09-20). MPS, Infineon-Delta or ADI-Empower win VPD sockets, which the licence lets the OEM buy from unlicensed suppliers. AI capex growth slows into 2028. NTM recurring EPS ~$4.50 x ~22x (lower half of the peer range) + $10 cash = ~$110.

base.story: This is my fair-value build: NTM recurring EPS $5.90 ex-interest, product $680M/$880M, VPD ~$17-22M/qtr. The multiple compresses from 48x to ~30x, inside the peer range but above the 25.5x median, because AI-power names have held premiums and the 337-TA-1484 decision and renewals are still open at the horizon. 5.90 x 30 + $10 cash + $10 licensing option = ~$197, which is $40 above my $157 fair value. That gap is the multiple I expect the market will still pay, not a different earnings view.

bull.story: The ITC case and the unlicensed hyperscalers approaching Vicor turn into new licences. Recurring royalties pass $250M/yr. Product reaches ~$1B in 2028 as Fab 1 tops out and Fab 2 starts. NTM EPS ~$9.75 x ~40x (MPWR's level, top of the peer range) + cash = ~$400.

comps_summary.peer_range: One basis: forward P/E on the next fiscal year, which is CY2027 for calendar-year companies (finviz 2026-10-06). Exceptions: ADI (FY Oct-2027) and IFX (FY Sep-2027, EUR 63.47 / EUR 2.85) are one quarter off; Delta uses StockAnalysis consensus 'EPS Next Year' TWD 64.32 at TWD 2,050 = 31.9x. Range 19.1x (ON) to 41.1x (MPWR), interquartile ~22.3-29.2x, median 25.5x (NVT). Forward EV/EBITDA is not shown: no source publishes it for these peers (citation fix 2026-10-06). ARM, RMBS, ALAB and CRDO from round 1 are dropped (not power companies, per supervisor comps_review); POWI, APH, BELFB and ON are added.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: VICR is at 48.1x CY2027 consensus EPS and ~62x my recurring CY2027 EPS. I apply the 25.5x median to product earnings and to total recurring EPS in the P/E method, and 20x to royalties in the SOTP (a discount, argued below). Blended ~23-25x on NTM-at-horizon EPS. The base scenario uses ~30x, which is inside the peer range (between POWI 29.2x and Delta 31.9x), as the price the market is likely to still pay in Oct-2027 after partial compression from today's 48x.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium in fair value. Faster growth is the only argument for one, and my horizon EPS is already 75% weighted to CY2028, which capitalises that growth; a further growth premium would count it twice. The supervisor's +20% (32x) rests on growth and ~100%-margin royalties, but royalty margin is already in EPS. Against a premium: product GM ~47% is below MPWR/ADI; capacity is capped at one fab until 2028; Vicor lost the H100 socket to MPS [17]; the majority of Advanced Products revenue comes from a few customers [3]; and the licences are two-year deals up for renegotiation inside the horizon [2]. Royalty discount (20x vs 25.5x): the licences are short, few and dependent on ITC leverage [2][13], so I expect the discount to persist through Oct-2027.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$125 the stock would trade at ~19x my NTM recurring EPS ex-cash, below the cheapest power peer (ON 19.1x), even though my EPS already strips out the fixed licence and any back-royalty. That price would mean the earnings base itself is failing: the VPD royalty run-rate is near zero, the two-year licences are not renewed in late 2027, 337-TA-1484 has failed, or product backlog ($379.7M) has rolled over. 95%-vol noise around a ~$190 median would not get there. On the upside, if Q3/Q4 show a VPD run-rate above ~$25M/qtr and the stock holds above ~$300, my skeptic fair value is too low.

reasoning: Round 2. Facts re-checked against primary sources. The Q2 transcript confirms the fixed $60M licence schedule (15/5/10x4, ending Q3-27) and the 'nearly 10%' July guide. The Sep-21 and Sep-30 releases confirm >30% and 'increased royalties' with no structure given. The 10-Q confirms 46.1M basic shares, 47.7M diluted, $453.6M cash, no debt and Q1 royalty $15.0M. EDGAR shows 10b5-1 Form 4s and a $150M buyback 8-K, and the USITC IDS record gives the 337-TA-1484 target of 2027-09-20 (re-checked 2026-10-06). Correcting Q3 product to ~$137M cuts the VPD royalty to ~$29M; I treat about half as back-payment, so the run-rate is ~$17M/qtr in 2027. Recurring EPS is $4.39 for CY2027 and $6.73 for CY2028, ~$5.90 ex-interest at the Oct-2027 horizon. Consensus CY2027 ($6.12-6.35) includes the fixed licence, any back-royalty and tax credits. On a consistent CY2027 basis the 11 power/AI-power peers have a median of 25.5x (range 19-41x). No premium is justified as persistent: growth is already in the CY2028-weighted EPS, the royalties are two-year deals, and Vicor has one fab and concentrated customers. Fair value is $157 (SOTP $159, P/E $160, DCF $146 after stating a 4.2%-of-revenue D&A add-back on 2026-10-06). Reconciliation: the base scenario ($197) uses the same earnings at ~30x, inside the peer range, as the multiple I expect to survive partial compression from 48x. Bear $110 (0.30) and bull $400 (0.25) bracket it, and the ladder is a lognormal mixture of these three (median ~$193, mean ~$222, P(>= spot) 0.23). That is lower than my round-1 P(>= spot) of 0.35 and the supervisor's 0.36, mainly because of the consistent-basis peer median and the smaller VPD royalty. The left tail is not thinner because 95% realised vol and three prior 50%+ retracements argue against confidence. Limits: about 6 new web lookups. In-lane share is ~46% (16 of 35) because the required comps table needs 11 data sources. sec.gov refused curl for documents, so filings were read with WebFetch. No option data and no priors were used. Citation fix 2026-10-06: Delta re-based to 31.9x (consensus FY2027 EPS TWD 64.32); forward EV/EBITDA removed (unsourced); PTAB wording corrected (IPR institution denied, May 2024); 95% realised vol re-cited to Twelve Data; DCF $151 -> $146 with a stated D&A add-back; fair value $158 -> $157; 12-month ladder shifted by 157/158.
